text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Keep the tracks spinning! Let's get it~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four—! 
—Yo, Zeph-chi, Tanmira!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Bam-chan too! 
Everybody dance~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Woo~ yeah~! Spring marks the start ♪ 
Dango tastes great!
Sprint down the sakura trail!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Kept sprinting ahead,
then saw it clear!
Future me grinning ear to ear!

text_block_list.name: Helios and Bamboo
text_block_list.text:
Future forecast rain or shine?
But wishing ♪ for clear blue skies ♪ Leap
into that azure high!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(—It is fun for me too... Helios, Bamboo,
Zephyr... 
Dancing alongside such kind souls...
fills me with joy.)

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...So gentle. Hands so warm... 
and comforting. —I see. Perhaps I...)

The special night concluded—
the following day.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Big congrats to me and Ojou for winning Best
Daaaaate~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes. Thank you for your assistance.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe,
that was pure hype! Did you have fun too,
Princess? 
Basically makes us ultimate duo,
right? BEST COUPLE?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Your fervor enraptured the entire audience.
That alone 
secured our victory as "Best Date," I
believe.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
My apologies.
I have prior engagements this evening, 
so I must decline.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I must take my leave. 
Please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Ojooooou—! 
Rejection stings,
but still love you~~~~~~~!
